inbodydescription.para: In order to resolve low-Temperature vapor reasonably well, the resolution in that range could either be increased or a fake "0 bar" value be invented. I decided to try the latter, i.e., i will use - in Table2 - a value at 0.005 bar, which is always below psat. This increases p_dim by 1 compared to earlier versions. This should probably also be invented in the H2O-NaCl Tables ...
